data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Filters, tick RV Site, type the destination, click FIND A KOA) and adds the optional check-in and check-out dates, with every input named as a parameter; it is slightly over-specified, for example by fixing the filter to stay-type and calling the dates required steps, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
